open_questions: Transit-to-transit depth scatter: transit_depths p_consistent 0.015096262306045561 with 3 transits, mean 7459 ppm vs refit 7475 ppm; needs higher-cadence follow-up to confirm stability and reject a few bad transits scenario.
Centroid localization was inconclusive and not run; on-target confirmation (difference imaging/SB2 test) remains to rule out a faint nearby EB at 18.8 arcsec.
dossier.public_summary: TESS shows a ~2-hour flat-bottomed dip repeating every 12.9 days with no secondary eclipse or significant odd-even change, consistent with a ~4 Earth-radius object transiting a small M dwarf. The depth is steady across two sectors and the duration fits the star, but only three transits were seen and they vary in depth, so on-target confirmation is still needed.

reasons.why: Strongly flat-bottomed (V sigma negative) favours a transit over a grazing binary, with ingress fraction 0.25 and fit b 0.1609.
Well below the stellar regime, Jupiter-sized even allowing for the larger Gaia radius; TIC radius 0.4278 and Gaia radii both give a ~4 Rearth planet.
reasons.value: 4.017 (4.42 with Gaia FLAME 0.4706 Rsun, 4.57 with GSP-Phot 0.4867 Rsun)

reasons.why: Duration 1.999 h matches a central transit for a 0.43-0.49 Rsun M dwarf (log_density_ratio 0.1332), stellar density penalty 0.0828; stellar_radius tool confirms fit with all radii.

No on-target centroid yet, but neighbours.plausible_within_1px 0 and closest that could 18.8 arcsec needing 0.4104 eclipse with delta_mag 4.36 cannot be ruled in by neighbours alone; centroid is inconclusive not off-target.

No significant secondary (below 5 sigma and below best_brightening_snr 6.045) and no significant odd/even difference below 4 sigma; sector_oe_max_sigma 2.601 and depth_difference 0.2691 not indicative of a double-period binary.
reasons.value: secondary snr 2.56 (at 0.6661 phase, 767.2 ppm), odd_even diff_sigma 1.971, depth_odd 6664 ppm vs depth_even 9117 ppm

reasons.why: Below median (0.5) but not low; supported by transits 3 (refit snr 12.82) and sectors p_constant 0.3416 depth_change 15.82 % showing no sector change, and transit_depths p_consistent 0.015 noted as open question.
